svg.text: review refresh-coverage keeps a review deck current as the PR iterates
One command re-runs the deck over the review's current range and reports what changed; it never accepts a proposal.

g.text: Moved: re-pinned without judgment
Current references whose lines only moved.
Whole-file references whose add, rename, mode or
delete event is still in the range survive edits
inside the file (a one-line gofmt no longer uncovers
256 lines). Each reference keeps its side: new-side
evidence stale at the head is never re-pinned to the
merge-base; it goes to judgment.
New lines: reported, with a proposed owner
Coverage means someone linked each changed line to its
explanation, so no Item is extended silently. The one
Item already holding the file is the proposed owner;
--accept-proposed [--path P] gives it the lines under a
neutral "added in <head>" note unless --note says more.
Several Items (or none) -> reported, with candidates.
Needs judgment: an edit landed inside
Stale references are listed with the proposed range,
its diff and the accept command. The proposed lines
are reserved, not handed out again as new.
Accept with repin --accept-proposed --review ID
after reading.
review refresh-coverage --review ID
[--accept-proposed [--path P] [--note TEXT]] [--repo PATH]
[--dry-run] [--json]. Plain records edit in place;
apply-slide slides take one transaction each. JSON: moved,
added, needs_judgment, uncovered (proposed_owner, accept).
Tested: a push that moves, edits, adds lines and a file;
accepting per path and with a note; an added file edited
again; a new-side reference a later push edited.
